title: Week-1 Evaluation Plan for Knee-Friendly Mobility and Joint Strengthening

tests.name: 30-Second Sit-to-Stand Test
tests.how: Sit on a standard chair and stand up fully then sit down as many times as possible in 30 seconds.
tests.targets: Assess lower limb strength and endurance.
tests.notes: Use a chair without armrests; keep arms crossed over chest.

tests.name: 2-Minute Step Test
tests.how: March in place lifting knees to midway between knee and hip height for 2 minutes.
tests.targets: Evaluate aerobic endurance and lower limb mobility.
tests.notes: Count the number of times the right knee reaches the target height.

tests.name: Comfortable Walk Duration
tests.how: Walk at a comfortable pace on flat ground for as long as possible up to 10 minutes.
tests.targets: Assess walking endurance and joint comfort.
tests.notes: Record total duration and any knee discomfort.

tests.name: Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE) Explanation
tests.how: Explain the Borg Scale from 6 (no exertion) to 20 (maximal exertion).
tests.notes: Aim for RPE between 11 (light) and 13 (somewhat hard) during sessions.

session: Warm-up: 5 minutes gentle marching in place.
Mobility: 2 sets of 10 knee circles each leg, slow controlled.
Strength: 2 sets of 12 seated banded leg extensions (self-anchored band).
Strength: 2 sets of 12 seated banded hamstring curls (self-anchored band).
Cool-down: 5 minutes seated knee flexion/extension stretches.
Warm-up: 5 minutes gentle marching in place.
Aerobic: 10 minutes stepping in place at a comfortable pace.
Mobility: 2 sets of 10 ankle circles each side.
Cool-down: 5 minutes seated calf and quadriceps stretches.
Warm-up: 5 minutes gentle marching in place.
Strength: 2 sets of 12 seated banded hip abductions (self-anchored band).
Strength: 2 sets of 12 seated banded hip adductions (self-anchored band).
Mobility: 2 sets of 10 slow heel slides lying or seated.
Cool-down: 5 minutes seated hamstring and calf stretches.
Goal: Walk at least 20 minutes at a comfortable pace outdoors or indoors.
Focus on maintaining an RPE of 11-13.
Include gentle knee mobility exercises before and after walking.

log_template.example: Felt stable during leg extensions; slight stiffness after walking.

safety_notes: All exercises should be performed within pain-free range. Stop immediately if sharp knee pain occurs. Use self-anchored resistance bands only; avoid door anchors. Warm-up and cool-down are essential to prevent injury. Maintain RPE between 11 and 13 to avoid overexertion. On walking days, choose flat, safe surfaces. Consult a healthcare provider if knee pain persists or worsens.
